services.name: Fishing Guides
services.desc: Fishing on the Kenai River is an essential experience for any angler. Situated just 50 miles south of Anchorage on the Kenai Peninsula, this river offers unparalleled accessibility and some of the finest fishing opportunities in Alaska, if not the world. Its abundance of Salmon, Trout, and Char, consistently astound even the most seasoned and well-traveled anglers. Despite all of Alaska having breathtaking areas, the allure of the Kenai River draws both locals and visitors back year after year. Selecting a seasoned, local Kenai River fishing guide stands as the cornerstone of your fishing experience. At Lost Boys Fishing, we take pride in offering you the finest guides available. Should

includes: All fishing gear including rods, reels, tackle, and waders up to size 13 shoe (larger by special request)
Fish cleaning and filleting at the river
blurb: Lost Boys Fishing offers guided fishing trips on the Kenai River targeting trophy trout and peak salmon runs. Trips accommodate all skill levels and include professional guides, fishing gear, and fish cleaning. They operate primarily during salmon and trout seasons from June through October.
extraNote: Trips run in most weather conditions; safety first and rescheduling if necessary · 15–25% gratuity standard for guides · June through October
